payload.title: Jev go/no-go: price a 500-bio subsample
payload.description: Price and cap a Jev run on a 500-bio subsample of the regulated-decisions pool before any request goes out, per the free-engines-before-paid-ones convention, then decide go/no-go on the full ~24,000-request run described in docs/regulated-decisions-preregistration.md.
